value.syntax: # [doc = " A `.regexp` pattern the crate cannot use."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Two arms and no third: a pattern the engine reports as not well formed"] # [doc = " under XML Schema rules, and a well-formed pattern the engine declines"] # [doc = " for a reason of its own. There is no translation arm, because there is"] # [doc = " no translator — the engine implements the XSD flavor itself."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Both arms carry the engine's own account rather than a location. The"] # [doc = " engine's error type offers no position into the pattern, and inventing"] # [doc = " one — reporting every refusal at character zero — would be a located"] # [doc = " error in name only."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " A pattern is compiled at `Theory::parse` and executed nowhere else, so"] # [doc = " the compile-time variants are reached only through"] # [doc = " [`TheoryError::Regexp`]; [`RegexpError::BudgetExhausted`] alone can"] # [doc = " arise at match time, and it is a refusal, never an answer."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{RegexpError, Theory, TheoryError};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let err = Theory::parse(r#\"e = {0 => \"com.example\", 1 => [0, 0, uint], 2 => tstr .regexp \"[a-\"}\"#)"] # [doc = "     .expect_err(\"the character class is not closed\");"] # [doc = " assert!(matches!(err, TheoryError::Regexp(RegexpError::Malformed { .. })));"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Debug , thiserror :: Error)] # [non_exhaustive] pub enum RegexpError { # [doc = " The pattern is not a well-formed XSD regular expression."] # [error ("pattern is not a well-formed XSD regular expression: {detail}")] Malformed { # [doc = " The engine's account of what was wrong."] detail : String , } , # [doc = " A well-formed pattern the engine declined for a reason of its own."] # [error ("engine refused the pattern: {detail}")] EngineRefused { # [doc = " The engine's account of why it declined."] detail : String , } , # [doc = " A match that did not complete within the seam's operation budget."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The budget counts matching operations, never time, so the same"] # [doc = " pattern, subject, and budget give the same outcome on every"] # [doc = " machine. This is the one failure the seam can raise at match time;"] # [doc = " the evaluator surfaces it as a located mismatch, never as a silent"] # [doc = " answer."] # [error ("pattern match exhausted the {budget}-operation budget")] BudgetExhausted { # [doc = " The budget that was in force."] budget : usize , } , }
